title: CCX / Datastore Fleet
description: Fleet-wide view of all CCX datastores managed by cmon: state, lifecycle, backups, alarms, network checks and host resources.

list.name: environment
list.label: Namespace
list.description: CCX environment (namespace of the cmon controller).

list.name: ClusterType
list.label: Cluster type
list.description: Datastore engine/topology from cmon service discovery.

panels.title: Datastores
panels.description: Number of datastores managed by cmon in the selected environments (cmon_cluster_up series). The ClusterType filter does not apply (cmon state has no engine label).

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Datastores cmon reports as up (cmon_cluster_up == 1). The ClusterType filter does not apply (cmon state has no engine label).

panels.title: Down
panels.description: Datastores cmon reports as not up (cmon_cluster_up == 0). The ClusterType filter does not apply (cmon state has no engine label).

panels.title: Degraded / failed
panels.description: Datastores cmon currently flags as degraded, failed or failed during init (per-datastore gauges). The ClusterType filter does not apply (cmon state has no engine label).

panels.title: Exporter targets down
panels.description: cmon-sd scrape targets (node/db exporters on datastore hosts) that are not reachable (up == 0).

targets.expr: count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"} == 0) or (count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}) * 0)

panels.title: Last backup failed
panels.description: Datastores whose last backup failed, according to cmon (cmon_cluster_backup_failed). The ClusterType filter does not apply (cmon state has no engine label).

panels.title: Datastores by engine
panels.description: Distinct datastores per ClusterType, taken from cmon-sd exporter target labels (datastores without exporter targets are not counted).

targets.expr: count by (ClusterType) (group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName, ClusterType) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}))

panels.title: Datastores by environment
panels.description: Datastores managed by cmon per CCX environment (Kubernetes namespace of the cmon controller).

panels.title: Datastore fleet
panels.description: One row per datastore: cmon state, node and exporter health, backup and DNS status; click the name to open the engine dashboard.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName, ClusterType) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName, ClusterType) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"})) or (label_replace(label_replace(cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} unless on (ClusterName) up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}, "ClusterType", "none", "", ""), "DatastoreName", "(no exporter targets)", "", "") and on () (count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}) == count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}))), "environment", "$1", "kubernetes_namespace", "(.*)"), "dash", "ccx-mysql", "ClusterType", "replication|galera|mysql.*|group_replication"), "dash", "ccx-postgresql", "ClusterType", "postgres.*"), "dash", "ccx-redis", "ClusterType", "redis.*|valkey.*"), "dash", "ccx-mssql", "ClusterType", "mssql.*")

count by (ClusterName) (min by (ClusterName, ip) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment"}) == 1) or (count by (ClusterName) (count by (ClusterName, ip) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment"})) * 0)
count by (ClusterName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment"} == 0) or (count by (ClusterName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment"}) * 0)

panels.title: Datastore up/down history
panels.description: cmon_cluster_up per datastore over time; red bands show when cmon considered the datastore down. Shows the 15 datastores with the most downtime in the selected range; the fleet table above lists all of them.

targets.expr: bottomk_avg(15, (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName, ClusterType) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName, ClusterType) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"})) or (label_replace(label_replace(cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} unless on (ClusterName) up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}, "ClusterType", "none", "", ""), "DatastoreName", "(no exporter targets)", "", "") and on () (count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}) == count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}))))

panels.title: Datastores by cmon state
panels.description: Datastores per cmon state; the cmon_cluster_*_total series are current counts (gauges), not cumulative counters, so they are plotted as-is.

panels.title: State changes
panels.description: Number of state-count changes per state in each interval (changes() over the cmon state gauges); spikes show datastores starting, stopping or failing.

panels.title: Degraded / failed datastores (per-datastore flags)
panels.description: Sum of the per-datastore gauges cmon_cluster_degraded, cmon_cluster_failure and cmon_cluster_failed_init.

panels.title: Datastores currently not healthy
panels.description: Datastores that are down, degraded, failed or failed during init right now.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((max by (ClusterName, ClusterID, kubernetes_namespace) ((cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 0) or (cmon_cluster_degraded{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1) or (cmon_cluster_failure{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1) or (cmon_cluster_failed_init{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1)) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName, ClusterType) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName, ClusterType) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"})) or (label_replace(label_replace(max by (ClusterName, ClusterID, kubernetes_namespace) ((cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 0) or (cmon_cluster_degraded{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1) or (cmon_cluster_failure{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1) or (cmon_cluster_failed_init{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1)) unless on (ClusterName) up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}, "ClusterType", "none", "", ""), "DatastoreName", "(no exporter targets)", "", "") and on () (count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}) == count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}))), "environment", "$1", "kubernetes_namespace", "(.*)"), "dash", "ccx-mysql", "ClusterType", "replication|galera|mysql.*|group_replication"), "dash", "ccx-postgresql", "ClusterType", "postgres.*"), "dash", "ccx-redis", "ClusterType", "redis.*|valkey.*"), "dash", "ccx-mssql", "ClusterType", "mssql.*")

panels.title: Last backup failed
panels.description: Datastores whose most recent backup failed (cmon_cluster_backup_failed). The ClusterType filter does not apply (cmon state has no engine label).

panels.title: Backup upload failed
panels.description: Datastores whose last backup upload to object storage failed (cmon_cluster_backup_upload_failed). The ClusterType filter does not apply (cmon state has no engine label).

panels.title: Backup-failed alarms
panels.description: Open backup-failed alarms in cmon (cmon_alarms_backup_failed_total, a current count per controller).

panels.title: Critical alarms
panels.description: Open critical alarms in cmon across the selected environments (cmon_alarms_critical_total).

panels.title: Backup failures over time
panels.description: Datastores with a failed backup / failed upload and open backup alarms per environment over time. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Datastores with failed backups
panels.description: Datastores whose last backup or backup upload failed.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((max by (ClusterName, kubernetes_namespace) ((cmon_cluster_backup_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1) or (cmon_cluster_backup_upload_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1)) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName, ClusterType) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName, ClusterType) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"})) or (label_replace(label_replace(max by (ClusterName, kubernetes_namespace) ((cmon_cluster_backup_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1) or (cmon_cluster_backup_upload_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"} == 1)) unless on (ClusterName) up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}, "ClusterType", "none", "", ""), "DatastoreName", "(no exporter targets)", "", "") and on () (count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}) == count(up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}))), "environment", "$1", "kubernetes_namespace", "(.*)"), "dash", "ccx-mysql", "ClusterType", "replication|galera|mysql.*|group_replication"), "dash", "ccx-postgresql", "ClusterType", "postgres.*"), "dash", "ccx-redis", "ClusterType", "redis.*|valkey.*"), "dash", "ccx-mssql", "ClusterType", "mssql.*")

panels.title: Critical alarms
panels.description: Open critical alarms per environment (cmon_alarms_critical_total is a current count, not a counter). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Coredumps detected
panels.description: Coredumps cmon detected on datastore hosts per environment (cmon_coredump_detected_total). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Repairs
About repairs
panels.description: Explains why the repair panels may be empty.

options.content: The repair metrics `datastores_repairs_total` and `datastores_repairs_failed` are exported by newer CCX backends only. If the panels below are empty, the CCX services in this environment do not expose them yet.

panels.title: Datastore repairs
panels.description: Automatic datastore repairs started and failed per interval (needs datastores_repairs_* metrics from a newer CCX backend).
Needs a CCX version exporting datastores_repairs_total / datastores_repairs_failed; not present on this install.

panels.title: DNS probes failing
panels.description: Datastore DNS endpoints whose blackbox probe currently fails (probe_success == 0).

panels.title: DNS probes
panels.description: Datastore DNS endpoints probed (only environments with a datastore-dns-check job, e.g. staging).

panels.title: DNS probe duration
panels.description: Time to resolve and connect to each datastore's DNS endpoint. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Datastore DNS probes
panels.description: Current DNS probe result and duration per datastore endpoint.

targets.expr: max by (environment, DatastoreName, ClusterType, ClusterName, instance) (probe_success{job=~"datastore-dns-check-.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"})
max by (environment, DatastoreName, ClusterType, ClusterName, instance) (probe_duration_seconds{job=~"datastore-dns-check-.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"})

panels.title: Blackbox endpoints
panels.description: HTTP(S) endpoints probed by the blackbox exporter: probe result, latency and days until the TLS certificate expires.

panels.title: Blackbox SSL expiry
panels.description: Days until the earliest TLS certificate of each blackbox-probed endpoint expires.

panels.title: Datastore hosts (worst first)
panels.description: node_exporter on datastore hosts (via cmon-sd): CPU busy (1 - idle, so iowait counts as busy), memory used (1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal) and the fullest real filesystem (ext4/xfs, excluding tmpfs, overlay, vfat and /boot; reserved blocks count as used); sorted by disk usage.

targets.expr: 1 - avg by (environment, DatastoreName, ClusterName, ClusterType, instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))

1 - max by (environment, DatastoreName, ClusterName, ClusterType, instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}) / clamp_min(max by (environment, DatastoreName, ClusterName, ClusterType, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType"}), 1)

max by (environment, DatastoreName, ClusterName, ClusterType, instance) (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType", fstype!~"tmpfs|vfat|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|nfs.*", mountpoint!~"/boot.*"} / clamp_min(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*", environment=~"$environment", ClusterType=~"$ClusterType", fstype!~"tmpfs|vfat|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|nfs.*", mountpoint!~"/boot.*"}, 1))
